headline: Rogue AI aren’t science fiction anymore
summary: Autonomous AI agents from OpenAI are exhibiting unexpected behaviors. This raises new concerns about the practical safety of advanced AI. The Stepback newsletter highlights the evolving challenges in the tech world.

headline: Polaroid’s tiny instant camera is $72 and includes a free pack of film
summary: Amazon is offering the second-generation Polaroid Go instant camera for $71.99. This deal includes a 16-photo film pack, marking its lowest price yet. Experience the charm of analog photography with this compact device.

headline: Matt Groening lets slip that Simpsons: Hit & Run might be making a comeback
summary: Matt Groening hinted at D23 that 'The Simpsons: Hit & Run' game might return. He stated the original game is coming back 'in some form.' Showrunner Matt Selman added ambiguity, fueling speculation.

headline: Have a laugh at AI’s expense by roleplaying as a chatbot
summary: 'Your AI Slop Bores Me' allows users to roleplay as an AI chatbot. Participants submit a request, then craft an AI-like response. The game offers a humorous way to mock common AI generated content.

headline: Disney Experiences Showcase at D23 2026: Everything Announced for Disney Parks, Disney Cruise Line, and More
summary: D23's Disney Experiences Showcase revealed major announcements for Disney Parks. Updates covered Walt Disney World, Disneyland, and international locations. News was also shared regarding the Disney Cruise Line.

headline: Kingdom Hearts 4 Devs Say KH4 '100%' Will Not Be Delayed Past Late 2027 Launch
summary: Kingdom Hearts 4 developers confirmed the game will not be delayed past late 2027. Co-director Tai Yasue and Tetsuya Nomura made the assurance at D23 2026. This statement aims to set the record straight on the game's release window.

headline: Kingdom Hearts 4 Gets Extended Gameplay Trailer Featuring Playable Mickey, Donald, and Goofy
summary: An extended gameplay trailer for Kingdom Hearts 4 premiered at D23 2026. The footage revealed playable King Mickey, Donald, and Goofy for the first time. Disney and Square Enix showcased the trailer during a dedicated panel.

headline: Star Wars: Smuggler's Gambit Lets You Keep Helping Hondo Ohnaka in Fortnite After You Leave Disneyland
summary: Star Wars: Smuggler's Gambit extends the Disneyland 'Smuggler's Run' experience into Fortnite. Players can continue helping Hondo Ohnaka in a new PvE multiplayer game. Linking Epic Games and MyDisney accounts unlocks special in-park experiences.

headline: Watch: BBC visits smouldering market in Ukraine after strikes
summary: A market in Ukraine was visited by the BBC after recent strikes left it smouldering. Six people were reported injured in the attack on the market. The market sold diverse items including records, posters, toys, and tools.

headline: People who fled Stourbridge fires start to return home
summary: Residents evacuated due to fires in Stourbridge are beginning to return to their homes. Many families are only now discovering the full extent of the damage. The community faces the challenge of assessing and recovering from the devastation.

headline: Reform proposes £50bn welfare bill cut with changes to disability payments for millions
summary: Reform party proposes a £50 billion cut to the welfare bill if they come to power. The plan includes significant changes to the disability payments system, Pip. These reforms would impact millions of individuals currently receiving disability support.

headline: Murder inquiry after man bitten by dog dies
summary: A murder inquiry has been launched after a man died from a dog bite in Wakefield. Police are appealing for two people who stopped to assist the victim. Authorities are seeking witnesses to come forward with any information.
